description: Field metadata for the Tax Planner input forms. Not financial-year specific (limits and eligibility come from the selected rule set). 'path' is the engine input path (see backend/tax/engine.py DEFAULT_INPUTS). 'rule_key' links a deduction to the rule set's regimes.<regime>.deductions.value.allowed list, so the UI can show which regimes allow it.

salary_components.label: Basic Salary
salary_components.help: Base for HRA, employer NPS and PF calculations.

salary_components.label: Dearness Allowance (forming part of retirement benefits)
salary_components.help: Counts with basic for the HRA and NPS salary base.

salary_components.label: House Rent Allowance (HRA)
salary_components.help: Partly exempt in the old regime if you pay rent.

payroll_deductions.label: Employee EPF
payroll_deductions.help: Counted towards 80C automatically in the old regime.

payroll_deductions.label: Voluntary Provident Fund
payroll_deductions.help: Counted towards 80C automatically in the old regime.

payroll_deductions.label: Professional Tax
payroll_deductions.help: Deductible in the old regime only, up to the rule set's cap.

employer_contributions.label: Employer PF
employer_contributions.help: Not part of taxable salary unless PF + NPS + superannuation exceed the aggregate cap.

employer_contributions.label: Employer NPS
employer_contributions.help: Added to salary, then deductible up to the regime's % of basic + DA (both regimes).

other_income.label: Municipal taxes paid on let-out property

capital_gains.label: Short-term gains on listed equity / equity funds (special rate)
Long-term gains on listed equity / equity funds (special rate, after exemption)

deduction_fields.label: Other 80C investments
deduction_fields.help: Do not include EPF/VPF here; payroll EPF/VPF is already counted.

deduction_fields.label: Your own NPS contribution
deduction_fields.help: Fills the additional 80CCD(1B) limit first, then the 80C pool.

deduction_fields.label: Donations (eligible amount)
deduction_fields.help: Enter the eligible deduction after 50%/100% and qualifying limits; the engine does not compute these.
